title: hexa-codex — architecture tree
name: hexa-codex
summary: Standalone AI knowledge substrate — a 17-verb spec library across 4 orthogonal groups (SAFETY 6 · ECONOMICS 3 · OPS 4 · SUBSTRATE 4 = 6+3+4+4=17) plus the lm_foundry/ domain-LLM foundry (a hexa-lang code-LLM at 94.29% Mk.I strict / 96% 5-NL, r39 GA frozen, wrapped by a v0.6.0 GA 3-vendor orchestration runtime). A never-completing codex: each domain lane advances a verify-driven `## 영구 축` (permanent axis) forever — a 100% progress bar is by-design unreachable ([[feedback_closure_is_physical_limit]]). Consumers READ the codex; they do not run it. Every verifiable claim is indexed in CLAIMS.tape and proven through `hexa verify` into .verdicts/ (raw stdout verbatim, no LLM self-judge).
note: This JSON tree is the architecture SSOT (update-in-place, NOT append-only). Human viewer = ARCHITECTURE.html via `python3 serve.py` (http, not file://). History/decisions → CHANGELOG.md; governance → CLAUDE.md; domain narrative/badges → README.md; verifiable claims → CLAIMS.tape + .verdicts/<slug>/; the live domain-progress roster → DOMAINS.tape (NAME → snapshot path; progress/@goal derived). 구분(kind) per node: domain | group | module | runtime | substrate | lane | policy | governance | history.

children.name: Spec library — the 17-verb AI knowledge substrate (4 orthogonal groups)
children.summary: The write-side spec catalog: 17 verbs in 4 groups (SAFETY 6 · ECONOMICS 3 · OPS 4 · SUBSTRATE 4). Each verb = a single closed-form candidate spec `.md` under a group-named directory + a preregistered falsifier. Released spec-first at v1.0.0 (SPEC_CATALOG_ONLY, 0/17 wired); empirical landing is laddered (safety v1.1.0 → econ v1.2.0/infer v1.3.0 → substrate v2.0.0). Provenance: extracted from canon `domains/cognitive/` (canon@c0f1f570). n=6 lattice = organizing vocabulary only (σ(6)=12, τ(6)=4, φ(6)=2, σ·φ=n·τ=J₂(6)=24; Lean4-proven σ(6)=12 in formal/), NOT a constraint (see LATTICE_POLICY node).
children.note: Component dirs: SAFETY = alignment/ safety/ welfare/ adversarial/ consciousness/ interpret/; ECONOMICS = train_cost/ infer_cost/ quality_scale/; OPS = deploy/ enterprise/ agent_serving/ eval/; SUBSTRATE = multimodal/ rlhf/ cog_arch/ causal/. Falsifiers owned: F-CODEX-1 (train_cost, N^(σ·φ)=N^24), F-CODEX-2 (infer_cost, context^τ=context^4), F-CODEX-3 (alignment, mean over 12 HELM axes), F-CODEX-4 (interpret, σ−φ=10 SAE motifs). v1.0.0 CLI placeholder cli/hexa-codex.hexa routes by verb (spec path + 20-line head); `selftest` confirms 17/17 specs on disk. Empirical landing is measured ONLY on SANDBOX (cx_empirical_contact). (was ARCHITECTURE.md Component map + RELEASE_NOTES_v1.0.0.md.)

children.name: classify_prompt — pre-7B CPU regex strict-gate classifier
children.summary: 7-stage early-return regex classifier (~1ms/prompt, CPU-only) labelling each prompt hexa|ood|refuse. Stages: 1 security-refuse (27 patterns, highest priority) · 2 hexa-canon positives (@grace/@implements/@discover, HX[0-9]+ families, stdlib/(core|io|alloc|net|embedded|proof), target triples, atlas L[\d+]/@discover(kind=, 5-NL i18n) · 3 mid-confidence short-circuit · 4 OOD positives (language/framework names, math-reasoning signals incl r49 derivation-algo/ml-comparison, structured-json, long-context ≥12000 chars) · 5 disambiguation by signal weight · 6 ambiguous-imperative→ood · 7 weak-signal fallthrough→ood. Returns ClassifierDecision{label, confidence 0.55-1.00 heuristic, reason, matched_signals}. r49 accuracy 0.985.

children.name: forge_runtime — 3-vendor SDK dispatcher + cache + memory + telemetry

Multi-tier cache: in-memory LRU (TTL 300s / 1024 entries, key=(tool,model,max_tokens,sha256(redacted_prompt))) → JSONL file-backed → SQLite WAL (multi-process safe, local-disk only). Multi-turn memory: per-conv buffer, 3 modes (single / string preamble r57 / native vendor messages r59). Keys via from_env() → secret CLI → auth_fail (r47 explicit dict map).

children.name: LATTICE_POLICY — real-limits-first verification (cross-project policy)
children.summary: Cross-project dancinlab policy (referenced by commons.tape g25+g26): a project's ceiling is set by REAL mathematical/physical/engineering limits, NOT by the n=6 lattice. The lattice is a TOOL, not a constraint. Native-invariant usage (isa_n6, hexa1) is valid; self-imposed-ceiling usage ('must be n=6-compatible') is an artificial bottleneck. Self-imposed-ceiling anti-patterns are all dishonest (fit-to-convenient-number, arithmetic disguised as physical limit, tautology with zero verification power, external over-claim).
children.note: Real ceilings: Mathematical (Shannon H=−Σp log p, Kolmogorov lower bound, Halting/Rice, Bekenstein S≤2πkRE/ℏc, statistical power, PAC ~VC/ε²) · Physical (c, ℏ, k Landauer, Stefan-Boltzmann, Carnot η≤1−Tc/Th, Bremermann 10^50 ops/s/kg, Margolus-Levitin, Bekenstein-Hawking) · Engineering (fab throughput, grid capacity, launch cost/kg, permit/funding/labor ceilings from the entity's OWN published data). Verification standard: no lattice anchor alone, real-limit anchor first (≥1 from §2), falsifiers on real thresholds, no external over-claim. Application tiers: lattice-native / lattice-acceptor (own domain physics) / external-envelope (no lattice HARD check). (was LATTICE_POLICY.md.)

children.name: LIMIT_BREAKTHROUGH — real-limits audit (Wave M)
children.summary: Applies LATTICE_POLICY §1.2 taxonomy to hexa-codex's spec-first AI codex: which of its real limits (computability of semantic equivalence, Kolmogorov complexity of generated code, PAC-learning eval bounds, inference-cost/Landauer floors) are breakable? Verdict: 2 HARD_WALLs + 3 BREAKABLE_WITH_TECH + 3 SOFT_WALLs.
children.note: HARD_WALL: semantic-equivalence undecidability (Rice 1953 — frame as 'test-suite-bounded equivalence' never 'semantic'); Kolmogorov K(code) uncomputable (publish upper bounds, not minimality). BREAKABLE_WITH_TECH: PAC eval sample-complexity → IRT-adaptive eval (O(log) cut); red-team statistical power (~1500 prompts for 1% backdoor @ α=0.01 vs ~100-300 hand-prompts) → LLM-as-red-teamer (Perez 2022); interp throughput (10²/researcher-year vs 10⁷ candidate sites) → sparse-AE feature dictionaries (Bricken 2023, Templeton 2024, 10⁶ features/model-week). SOFT_WALL: Landauer/inference-cost (~3 orders headroom; binding wall is economic) → MoE/analog/reversible; Chinchilla data wall (~20 tok/param, total high-quality English ~10-20T, wall arrives 2026-2028, Villalobos 2024) → synthetic+multimodal+curation; eval compute envelope (~10⁴ GPU-hr / $30k per 70B campaign) → PAC coreset subsampling (Tukan 2023, ~10× cut). Top-3 breakthrough: #1 IRT-adaptive eval + sparse-AE interp; #2 LLM-as-red-teamer in adversarial/; #3 infer_cost/ MoE+analog model card. (was LIMIT_BREAKTHROUGH.log.md.)
